newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Moody's upgrades Handelsbanken rating to B.
newsitem.headline: Moody's upgrades Handelsbanken rating to B.

text.p: Credit rating agency Moody's on Wednesday said it had upgraded Swedish commercial bank Handelsbanken's financial strength rating to B from C+.

"The upgrade reflects the increased predictability of Handelsbanken's earnings and Moody's confidence that the group will be able to maintain better earning profitability," Moody's said in a statement.
But the agency said the bank and its competitors' recurring earning power remained under pressure as a result of strong competition and further consolidation in the system was likely to occur.
"In this context we expect Handelsbanken to maintain its traditional risk-adverse strategy and its sound core capitalisation," Moody's said.
